context_requirements: Voltage-gated sodium channel expression or activity is not required for the main transcriptional response.
Cytotoxicity or mitochondrial/ER stress at 10 micromolar is needed for the late stress and growth-arrest signature.
Hepatocyte-like or breast-cancer metabolic context may amplify the response.
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed late stress or proliferation genes at 24 h in any cell line.
A strong, reproducible 6 h transcriptional signature shared across all nine lines.
Selective upregulation of SCN1A/SCN5A/SCN10A-dependent neuronal genes without stress or growth-arrest changes.
